A fresh 30-day Developer scratch org was created for these browser captures.
Capture date: 2026-11-09 UTC.
Route: Lightning Experience custom tab with synthetic LWC and LightningModal.
The tab and modal bundle metadata each declared the API version in org.tsv.
probe.html and modal.html describe the rendered inputs. Icon rows record svg
class; button rows record button class; modal rows record dialog section class.
Invalid size/variant controls record the resulting fallback rather than a rejection.
The scratch org was deleted after capture; a subsequent lookup did not find it.
